headline: Russia-bound ship towed after drone attack in Gulf of Finland
pages: A Russian cargo ship hit by a drone attack in the eastern Gulf of Finland is being towed away, authorities said. The Sparta II was bound for Kaliningrad when it was struck on Saturday morning and caught fire. It drifted into Finnish waters and its crew was evacuated to Russia. Finnish defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind the attack. Kyiv has not commented. By Sunday afternoon the fire was no longer visible, though thermal cameras showed some containers still warm. Finnish authorities said the ship was slightly listing but stable, with no fuel or hazardous leaks detected.

Kaliningrad's governor said two drones appeared to have been used and that supplies to the region are not threatened. The US and Ukraine have both sanctioned the ship, which is run by a company tied to Russia's defence ministry. Source: BBC News.
